outline:
This course aims at providing graduate students with the essential mathematical background for digital communications and communication networks. The course contains the following topics:

Part 1. Review of Probability And Random Variables
Part 2. Basic Concepts of Random Processes (Random Signals)
a. Introduction to Random Processes
b. Real-Valued Gaussian Random Vectors And Processes
c. Karhunen–Loeve Representation
Part 3. Applications of Random Processes
a. Detection Theory
b. Estimation Theory
c. Poisson Processes, Markov Processes, And Queuing Theory
